_comment: Created 2026-07-15 (A3 glass-bar concierge). Self-contained Vite + Svelte 5 SPA that renders inside an iframe and streams the grounded concierge chat from /paw-bar/chat. Nested under app/ so the frozen vanilla widget in ../src stays untouched (own package.json, own lockfile, own node_modules — all git-ignored via root .gitignore). Dep versions pinned to the exact aged builds paw-enterprise ships (7-day supply-chain min-age satisfied). Zero Ripple, zero SvelteKit.
name: paw-bar-glass
description: Glass concierge iframe app for Paw Bar — markdown-rich grounded chat, white-label headless surface.
